name: Yumemiyakawa Otoha
source: The student council president who is also [url=/c20898]Naho's[/url] biggest enemy because of her position and due to the fact that she's against the Love Committee and impure sexual relationships between boys and girls. Otoha is a hardworking and proactive girl who is kind towards girls, but not as lenient towards boys.
